scope: Source fidelity, authored projection and bounded durability-reference checks; not live runtime or numerical balance.

checks.name: 43 source identities exactly once
Every complete original source record is preserved losslessly
Source hash and recipe indices match actual original
All 32 protected original and prior reviewed files are unchanged
27 public / four restricted / twelve Director-only formulas remain exact
Public manuscript contains no gated recipe names or IDs and no Director guidance
27 public book bindings equal actual V5 paragraphs
All exact effects parse independently to unchanged numerical projections
27 weapons / 16 armor effects / ten elemental riders accounted
Forty finite base models are shared identically by public and internal projections
All 38 catalog bases retain their full reviewed equipment records
Every family and fixed armor mapping uses its exact reviewed whitelist
New accessories have exact price/mass/HP, pair identity and Standard-only grade
Base reserves and all result quantities independently recompute
Ordered base identities survive outcomes and cannot be acquired or reordered after roll
Failed/Mishap returns bases without duplicating source ingredient recovery
Actual bodies fund mass; tool/fuel/solvent and special inputs add no free body mass
All sixteen reusable source tool rows are preserved and exact catalyst occurrences remain separate
Only current mechanics.tag is operative; whole-creature and legacy fields supply no powers
All field flags remain false despite source timeMode labels
Work times, source DCs, assistant caps and actual first phases remain exact
Forge Dwarf creation minutes and phase caps independently recompute
Station duplication and unprinted fuel charges are excluded without dropping printed inputs
Flat weapon enhancement applies to actual attacks once, including thrown/off-hand, without critical doubling
Weapon grade accuracy competes with recipe enhancement, with no imaginary zero
Elemental dice belong to one attack event and double on critical, with optional pre-damage choice
Rider frequency follows physical item and actual turn, including off-turn/extra-turn rules
Rider respects genuine object/ally eligibility and does not mint copy/companion permissions
Outside rider timing has six-second windows and both initiative transition guards
One defense-enhancement family leaves base shield contribution outside it
Donned shield resistance is independent from selected shield AC and never stacks to immunity
Accessories occupy one slot each, no actual hands or armor classification, and don/doff in one Action
Structural profiles preserve real material and size without ingredient-derived defenses
Quality percentages replace rather than multiply and one flaw applies last
Durability worked cases preserve actual damage and prior flaws
Durability state sweep preserves deficits and bounds without repeated multiplication
Repair needs actual proficiency but gives no formula access or crafting rewards
HP-positive and HP-zero repairs use distinct exact prices, DCs and times
Suppression leaves structural workmanship unchanged and Broken leaves physical drawbacks
Every model-choice price, repair reference, reserve cost and physical mass independently recomputes
Worked source economics preserve 92+15 and 94/5+10 instead of overwriting source values
Every card prints its current source effect, operational text, all component occurrences and work
Every component occurrence and source work requirement is printed within its own unique card
Source conferences are recorded without exact-card, runtime or balance approval
